full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric oil painting shows an empty dirt path curving along a still teal river at dusk. The path begins wide in the lower foreground, narrows toward the center, and bends out of sight behind a cluster of slender trees at the right. Dark earth, scattered fallen leaves, and patches of damp ochre light cover its uneven surface. To the left, quiet water fills a broad strip from foreground to the hazy distance. Its green-blue surface reflects almost no hard detail, only soft shifts of tone. A low stump and a few thin reeds stand near the bank where the path approaches the water. Tall autumn trees rise on the right, their black trunks and delicate branches partially silhouetted against a dim blue-gray sky. One group of leaves near the upper right catches a brilliant amber glow, making a warm focal point against the surrounding cool mist. Farther across the water, wooded banks fade into soft charcoal silhouettes, and the distance disappears into fog. The viewpoint is human height and slightly above the path, inviting the eye to follow the warm curve into the obscured depth. Brushstrokes are loose and layered, especially in the foliage and earth, while the water and sky are softly blended. A grainy canvas texture shows through dark passages. Light seems to leak through the trees from beyond the bend, touching the path and leaves but leaving much of the scene in deep brown shadow. The whole frame feels hushed, damp, and expectant, held together by the subtle meeting of teal twilight and gold illumination.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形氛围油画呈现黄昏时一条沿静谧青绿河流弯曲的空土路。小径从下方前景宽宽起步，到中央变窄，再绕过右侧一簇细树消失。深色泥土、零落秋叶和潮湿赭光斑布满不平整路面。左侧平静水面从前景延伸到雾蒙蒙远方，蓝绿色表面几乎不映出清晰细节，只呈现柔软色调变化。一截低树桩与几根细芦苇立在道路靠近水的岸边。高大秋树在右侧升起，黑色树干与纤细枝条部分剪影于暗淡蓝灰天空前。右上附近一簇树叶接住明亮琥珀光，在周围冷雾中成为暖色焦点。河对岸较远的林地淡化为柔软炭灰轮廓，远处消失在雾里。视点处于人体高度、略高于小径，引导视线沿温暖弯线进入模糊纵深。笔触松散且层层叠加，枝叶与土壤尤其如此；水面与天空则柔和融合。深暗区域透出颗粒画布肌理。光似乎从转弯后方穿过树木，触及道路与叶片，画面大部分仍留在深棕阴影中。整幅作品静谧、潮湿且带期待感，由青绿暮色与金色照明的细微相遇凝聚。
style_prompt_en: The atmospheric oil-painting style builds depth with broad soft masses, loose layered strokes, and gradual loss of detail into mist. Cool teal and blue-gray dominate spacious shadowed areas, while selective amber and ochre light creates a concentrated warm path through the image. Edges dissolve in the distance but remain textured and broken nearby. Thin dark vertical marks provide rhythm against horizontal washes and a gently curving lead-in line. Paint is visibly granular, with scumbled highlights and dark underlayers giving the surface a damp, tactile quality. Illumination is low and diffused, interrupted by one glowing patch rather than spread evenly. A foreground-to-distance progression pulls the gaze inward without hard perspective lines. The composition stays sparse and quiet, letting color temperature and soft tonal transitions carry the mood. The overall effect is reflective, cinematic, and gently mysterious.
style_prompt_zh: 这种氛围油画风格以宽阔柔和色块、松散层叠笔触和向雾中逐渐消失的细节建立纵深。冷青绿和蓝灰色主导宽大的阴影区域，局部琥珀与赭色光则在画面里形成集中的暖色路线。边缘在远方消融，在近处保持有肌理且断续。细瘦深色竖线对照横向色层与一条轻弯的引导线，形成节奏。颜料颗粒明显，干擦高光与深色底层使表面带有潮湿触感。照明低而漫散，被一处发亮区域打断，而非均匀铺开。从前景到远方的渐进把视线向内拉入，不需要生硬透视线。构图保持稀疏安静，让色温与柔和明度过渡承载情绪。整体效果沉思、如电影般且略带神秘。
theme_en: A misty autumn path curving beside a still teal river
theme_zh: 静谧青绿河畔弯曲的秋雾小径
name: Brent Cotton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
